name: Heated Windshield
description: Windshield with embedded heating elements or conductive coating for rapid defogging and de-icing. Premium feature especially valuable in cold climates like Alaska.

common_on.notes: Available as option on most models 2015+

notes: Heated windshields are less common than ADAS or rain sensors. Ford is the most common domestic brand offering this. Very desirable in Alaska market.
